propositions: Project routing overlay cannot currently extend built-in overlay triggers; glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays read only committed routing via applies_to_globs and hardcoded deletion-impact regex

Built-in overlay entries in project code_review section must support additive trigger_tokens (literal substring matching on diff lines) and applies_to globs that union with committed values without replacing them

A new project_trigger_extensions() helper in registry.py reads project overlay raw code_review entries and returns per-built-in-overlay-id trigger_tokens and applies_to lists, which glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays consume via union
Malformed project entries (non-list trigger_tokens, non-string tokens, unknown overlay ids) must be ignored at consumption without raising errors
With no project overlay present, both trigger functions must return identical results to current behavior; all pre-existing tests in test_code_review_deletion_impact.py pass unmodified
